title.en: Complete twelve-language authentication and header consistency
title.zh: 完成十二语言登录与页眉一致性修复

purpose.en: Remove the English-only authentication fallback and align GreatLoveMeta's language and account controls with the shared SmartClass shell contract.
purpose.zh: 移除登录页回退英文的问题，并按共享 SmartClass 外壳规范统一大爱元宇宙的语言与账户控件。

en: Render the sign-in page and complete email-code form in every one of the twelve selectable interface languages.
Place the native-language text control before the account icon, use a solid down chevron, and remove the mobile globe icon.
zh: 十二种可选界面语言都完整呈现登录页及邮箱验证码表单。
语言文字控件位于账户图标之前，使用实心下箭头，并移除移动菜单中的地球图标。

en: Twelve localized /[lang]/auth/login routes and their authentication controls.
Desktop and hamburger language controls, deployment checks, and Project release history.
zh: 十二个本地化 /[lang]/auth/login 路由及其登录控件。
桌面与汉堡菜单语言控件、部署检查和项目发布历史。

en: Add site-owned static authentication copy for all twelve locale paths without runtime translation calls.
Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, Clerk flow, independent data, and cloud resources.
zh: 为十二个语言路径新增站点自有的静态登录文案，不进行运行时翻译请求。
保留大爱元宇宙品牌、Clerk 登录流程、独立数据及云资源。

en: Complete repository tests, production build, artifact and shared gates pass before publication.
Production Chrome click-through checks verify Japanese and Korean sign-in titles, headings, fields, actions, locale URLs, and responsive shell behavior.
zh: 发布前通过完整仓库测试、生产构建、制品及共享门禁。
生产 Chrome 实际点击检查日语与韩语登录标题、页面标题、字段、操作、语言 URL 和响应式外壳行为。

en: Clerk-delivered verification email content remains controlled by the site-owned Clerk application; this release localizes the website flow.
zh: 验证码邮件正文仍由站点自有 Clerk 应用控制；本次发布本地化网站登录流程。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, ecosystem destinations, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting true locale routing.
zh: 采用真实语言路由时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、生态目的地、独立数据与云资源。
